item.title: Diesel prices hit record highs amid Strait of Hormuz disruption and Russia-Ukraine war
item.description: The average diesel price remained near a record $6.43 per gallon as of Friday morning, according to the latest data.

item.title: Warren Buffett to step aside as Berkshire Hathaway chairman
item.description: Warren Buffett announced in a letter to shareholders Friday that he is stepping aside as Berkshire Hathaway chairman.

item.title: Warren Buffett steps down as Berkshire Hathaway chairman
item.description: Warren Buffett is stepping down as chairman of Berkshire Hathaway after more than 50 years in the role.

item.title: High school teacher discovers T. rex tracks in North Dakota
item.description: Denver Museum of Nature & Science research associate Kent Hups discusses finding T. rex footprints in the Badlands.
